scope: All 19 workbook sheet layouts were visually inspected in 95 rendered top/last/horizontal section panels. The artifact renderer was used for quality assurance only; delivered workbook creation uses portable openpyxl.
numeric_validation_report: Each executed run writes tables/workbook_validation.json and tables/workbook_cell_lineage.json.
notes: Base scientific and provenance sheets were reviewed in 73 panels; four main-figure source sheets were reviewed in 22 panels.
Column-sensitive wrapping and explicit Yes/No values resolved two layout issues; no unresolved clipping or lost numeric signs remained.

Scientific limits remain visible beside tables, including n=3 RNA pools, discovery chronology, observed-span qualification, conditional-noise interpretation and partition ranges not confidence intervals.
The final pipeline writes fresh workbook values and checks each displayed CSV field again; this static report documents layout review of the builder.
Raw QA images and intermediate workbooks are not runtime package dependencies.
Artifact-renderer review does not certify native Microsoft Excel or Windows PowerShell execution.
upstream_metadata_note: During review, blank n-unit entries in some figure-source records were reported to the figure author. Final source metadata is exported afresh by the pipeline.
